company_name: DALIAN CLEAN GAS PURIFICATION TECHNOLOGY LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides high-purity gas purification equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Dalian Clean Gas Purification Technology Ltd. designs and manufactures high-purity gas purification equipment for the semiconductor industry. Utilizing pressure swing adsorption technology, they produce industrial nitrogen generators and gas purification systems that meet stringent pressure vessel standards, ensuring reliability and compliance.
